title: Looking Up in Prague
description: Stumbling upon David ?erný's whimsical "Hanging Man" sculpture suspended high above a quiet street corner.
altText: A bronze sculpture of a man in a suit holding a briefcase and hanging by one hand from a red umbrella, suspended high above a street corner next to a historic building in Prague.

title: Morning Light over Old Town Square
description: Pausing to admire the ornate Baroque facades and towering monuments that guard Prague's historic heart.
altText: A view of Prague's Old Town Square showing the historic bronze Jan Hus Memorial statue in the foreground, flanked by ornate, colourful historic buildings with red roofs under a bright blue sky.

title: Tracking Time in Old Prague
description: Getting lost in the intricate blue, gold, and stone details of the medieval Astronomical Clock.
altText: Extreme close-up of the medieval Prague Astronomical Clock showing its detailed blue and gold astronomical dial, the calendar dial below it, and decorative gothic sculptures on the stone tower.

title: A Pastel Palette in the City
description: Walking past a beautiful, sunlit row of historic Prague homes, each painted in its own soft, classic hue.
altText: A row of colourful historic buildings in Prague with pastel facades in yellow, green, grey, and red, featuring traditional windows and steep roofs against a deep blue sky. Hero for Prague page.

title: Silent Tunnels
description: A contemplative moment staring down a deeply sobering archway woven entirely from history at the Sedlec Ossuary.
altText: A dark stone archway tightly lined and framed entirely by hundreds of stacked human skulls and bones, with four distinct skulls sitting on a wooden ledge in the foreground.

title: Whispers of the Past
description: An intimate look at the hauntingly beautiful, intricate bone structures that fill the Sedlec Ossuary.
altText: A close-up, low-angle shot inside the Sedlec Ossuary showing a pillar stacked with human skulls and crossbones, with a large, ornate bone chandelier hanging in the background.

title: Spires and Skulls
description: Looking up at the striking Gothic exterior of the Bone Church, where historic architecture meets solemn symbolism.
altText: The stone facade and towers of the Sedlec Ossuary chapel against a blue sky, featuring prominent gold skull-and-crossbones emblems atop the spires and a statue of the Virgin Mary.

title: A Splash of Yellow
description: Capturing the ornate details of an antique clock mounted on a vibrant, sun-drenched facade in Prague.
altText: An intricate black wrought-iron clock with gold accents and decorative script hanging from the corner of a bright yellow historic building adorned with flower boxes.

title: Melodies in the Courtyard
description: Stopping to listen as street musicians fill the courtyard of Prague's historic U Flek? beer garden with live sound.
altText: Musicians performing in the tree-shaded courtyard of the U Flek? brewery beer garden in Prague, with historic buildings and outdoor seating in the background.

title: Tracks and Taps
description: Watching model trains deliver pints along the bar at Výtopna - a railway-themed restaurant where dinner arrives on tiny tracks.
altText: A model train carrying small glasses of beer along miniature railway tracks built into the wooden bar counter at the Výtopna Railway Restaurant in Prague.

title: All Aboard for Dinner
description: Following the miniature railway as it winds through tables at Výtopna - part meal, part spectacle.
altText: A perspective view along the model train tracks running through the interior of the Výtopna Railway Restaurant in Prague, with tables and diners alongside the rails.

title: Gothic Dreams
description: Looking up at the twin Gothic spires of the Church of Our Lady before Týn rising above Old Town Square.
altText: The dark Gothic twin spires and ornate facade of the Church of Our Lady before Týn dominating the skyline above colourful historic rooftops in Prague's Old Town.

title: A Cobblestone Florist
description: Pausing at a rustic florist's shop where flowers spill from a weathered green facade onto the cobblestones.
altText: A charming rustic florist storefront with a green-painted facade, flower boxes, and bouquets displayed outside on a cobblestone street in Prague.

title: Chasing the Red Trams
description: Catching a vintage red and cream tram as it rattles over Prague's cobblestone streets.
altText: A classic red and cream Prague tram turning along a cobblestone street lined with historic buildings and overhead wires.

title: Reaching for the Sky
description: A low-angle view of the Old Town Hall tower stretching upward against a bright Czech sky.
altText: A dramatic low-angle shot looking up the ornate Gothic tower of Prague's Old Town Hall against a vivid blue sky.

title: Overlooking Prachov Rocks
description: Standing above the sandstone labyrinth of Prachov Rocks in the Bohemian Paradise - where prehistoric stone giants rise from the forest.
altText: A wide panoramic view from a rocky overlook across the dramatic sandstone rock formations and dense green forest of Prachov Rocks in the Bohemian Paradise. Hero for Czech page.

title: Giants of the Bohemian Paradise
description: Getting closer to the vertical sandstone pillars that define this protected landscape north of Prague.
altText: Tall, weathered sandstone rock pillars and needles rising from a forested hillside in the Bohemian Paradise near Prachov Rocks.

title: Navigating the Needle's Eye
description: Squeezing through a narrow canyon path carved between towering rock walls at Prachov.
altText: A narrow dirt hiking path winding through a tight rock canyon between massive vertical sandstone cliffs at Prachov Rocks.

title: Shaded Trails of Prachov
description: Following quiet, mossy paths that snake beneath the shadows of prehistoric stone giants.
altText: A dirt hiking trail winding through a peaceful forest clearing at the base of massive, vertical sandstone cliffs and tall trees at Prachov Rocks. Hero for Wilderness page.

title: Steps Hidden in Stone
description: Climbing a narrow stone staircase cut into the rock - part trail, part geological puzzle.
altText: A steep narrow stone staircase carved into and between natural sandstone rock walls inside a gorge at Prachov Rocks.

title: Reaching Pillars
description: Looking up at sandstone needles that seem to lean toward the sky above the treeline.
altText: Tall, slender sandstone rock pillars and pinnacles rising above a pine forest against a bright blue sky at Prachov Rocks.

title: The Labyrinth from Above
description: A panoramic view across the maze of sandstone pinnacles scattered through the Bohemian forest.
altText: An elevated panoramic view over a dense forest interspersed with dramatic clusters of sandstone rock formations and pinnacles in the Bohemian Paradise.

title: Green Horizons
description: Surveying an endless canopy of Bohemian forest stretching to the horizon.
altText: A wide vista across a vast expanse of dense green forest canopy under a soft overcast sky in the Czech countryside.

title: Framed by Nature
description: Sunlit cliffs glimpsed through a natural window of green branches.
altText: Sandstone cliffs and rock faces seen through a frame of green tree branches and foliage in a Bohemian forest.

title: Between Giant Walls
description: Walking a narrow chasm where two massive rock walls lean close enough to feel the scale.
altText: A narrow hiking path through a deep rock chasm between two towering vertical sandstone walls at Prachov Rocks.

title: Finding Scale in the Forest
description: Standing small beside a cliff face that towers over the pines.
altText: A massive textured sandstone cliff face rising above tall pine trees in a Bohemian forest, emphasizing the scale of the rock formations.

title: Nature's Window
description: Peering out from the darkness of a rock shelter toward sunlit forest beyond.
altText: A view from inside a dark natural rock cave or overhang looking out through an opening at sunlit green forest and cliffs beyond.

title: Forest Floor Details
description: Noticing the small world at our feet - moss, ferns, and wild mushrooms on the forest floor.
altText: A close-up of a mossy forest floor with ferns, fallen leaves, and small wild mushrooms growing among the undergrowth.

title: Looking to the Canopy
description: Tilting upward along a thick tree trunk toward the canopy above.
altText: A low-angle view looking straight up a thick tree trunk into the green canopy of a Bohemian forest.

title: Edge of the Forest
description: Peering down from a rocky cliff edge where forest meets open sky.
altText: A high-angle view looking down from a rocky cliff edge over a dense green forest canopy below.

title: Stone Sentinels
description: Sandstone formations standing like sentinels above the treeline.
altText: Dramatic sandstone rock formations and pillars rising above a dense forest canopy in the Bohemian Paradise.

title: Hidden Wonders
description: Spotting bright yellow wild mushrooms among the moss - small discoveries on the trail.
altText: A close-up of small bright yellow wild mushrooms growing on a mossy log or forest floor in a Bohemian woodland.

title: Framing the Wild at Adršpach
description: Viewing the Adršpach-Teplice rock city from a natural stone shelter.
altText: A vista of the dramatic sandstone rock formations of Adršpach-Teplice Rocks seen from inside a natural rock shelter or cave opening.

title: The Labyrinth of Adršpach
description: Climbing stone steps wedged between towering rock faces in Adršpach's famous gorge.
altText: A narrow stone staircase wedged between massive vertical sandstone rock walls in the Adršpach-Teplice rock labyrinth.

title: The Rails to Adršpach
description: Watching a regional train carry us toward the rock city - red carriages against a Bohemian village backdrop.
altText: A red and cream Czech regional train passing through a small village with hills and forest in the background on the route toward Adršpach.
